parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application. You can obtain the application ID on the **Application Management** page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The ID of the job. You can obtain the ID on the **Task Management** page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace. You can obtain the ID of the namespace on the **Namespace** page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 delete-job --job-id 92583 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
